name_input: LUK PLASTCON LIMITED; LUK PLASTCON LTD

Export-direction row: "2025-12-13 | LUK PLASTCON LIMITED | TO THE ORDER | BLACK MASTERBATCH WITH FILLER BLACK PEARL LP 2040- | MIHAN ICD, India | Kampala, Uganda | 32064990 | 7856742" — i.e. shipper = LUK PLASTCON, origin MIHAN ICD (India), destination Kampala, Uganda, HS 32064990, B/L 7856742. Port-lane counter on the same page lists "Kampala 5" shipments, so at least 5 Uganda-bound export rows are indicated, of which 1 full row was visible in the free view. Source counter: page states "Total Shipments 132 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 5"; rows actually seen in the free table = 5 (4 import rows + 1 export row). Only 1 of the indicated 5 Kampala export rows was readable — the other 4 are behind the paywall and are NOT verified.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. ImportKey shows only customs records, not domestic sales. Note: the 4 import rows visible (e.g. "2026-02-15 | SI GROUP, INC | LUK PLASTCON LIMITED | WESTON 705/190 KG DRUM LIQUID PHOSPHITE ANTIOXIDANT | NEW YORK JOHN F K, UNITED STATES | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | 38123990 | 7541252") prove the company is an active operating buyer of polymer additives/calcium carbonate/masterbatch inputs, which is consistent with in-house compounding, but inbound raw-material purchases are not evidence of domestic supply.
note: Export side is confirmed by one concrete customs row: LUK PLASTCON as shipper, MIHAN ICD -> Kampala, Uganda, 2025-12-13, HS 32064990 (black masterbatch with filler), B/L 7856742; the port counter indicates 5 Kampala rows total, only 1 readable. Declared HS 390469 (fluoropolymers, per the batch record) does NOT match the observed trade: actual codes seen are 32064990 (masterbatch/pigment preparations, export) and 38249900 / 38123990 (calcium carbonate, phosphite antioxidant — imports). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual 32064990 for the export line, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: manufacturer_trader is plausible (imports raw additives, ships compounded masterbatch) but not proven from public data. Domestic supply: no evidence found either way — not 'conditionally accepted', simply unverified because all Indian registry/GST sources were blocked (403) and search was down; revenue and domestic turnover = null, not estimated. PAN AABCL0612K and CIN were not independently verified in this session (no accessible registry).
